integrity: Exact tree recursion and marked exponential generating function; logarithmic transfer with a uniform complex neighborhood; independent exact-rational finite checks. All infinite conclusions follow from the analytic proof, not enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Uniform increasing recursive trees; root essentiality and outdegree; local complex-uniform asymptotics only. Does not resolve other vertex marks, multiple essential vertices, or large deviations.
title: A mod-Poisson root-degree law under maximum-independent-set rigidity in recursive trees
